title: Autodesk agrees to buy MaintainX, a company focused on maintenance tools, in an all-cash deal that values MaintainX at $3.6B (Brody Ford/Bloomberg)
summary: Brody Ford / Bloomberg: Autodesk agrees to buy MaintainX, a company focused on maintenance tools, in an all-cash deal that values MaintainX at $3.6B — Engineering software maker Autodesk Inc. has agreed to buy MaintainX, a firm focused on maintenance tools. — The all-cash deal will value MaintainX at $3.6 billion, Autodesk said in a statement Thursday.
